description: Ship-system input A/B (inside variant). Same bracket-tagged ship reports as ship_systems_outside_v1, but wrapped in <think>...</think> at the head of each operator turn. Tests whether the wrap-in-think trick observed on STAGE creative tags transfers to technical inputs: does it improve register/absorb-not-acknowledge, and does it hurt technical-competence (key_facts referencing)? Each turn is independent.
